meta.name: quantitative-analysis
meta.description: Answers a business question with data without fooling yourself — framing the question so an answer would change something, choosing the right comparison, checking the data before trusting it, recognizing the traps that produce confident wrong answers (aggregation reversals, survivorship, regression to the mean, multiple comparisons), and reporting uncertainty honestly. Use this to run an analysis, review one before acting on it, or work out why two people looking at the same data reached opposite conclusions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规避统计陷阱,用数据得出可信结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需用数据支撑决策，又担心结论被偏差误导
copy.tagline_en: Avoid statistical traps and reach trustworthy conclusions from data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often use data to support decisions but worry about flawed conclusions

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会帮你用数据回答业务问题:先想清楚问题能否改变行动,选对比较基准,检查数据是否可靠,识别常见陷阱(如汇总反转、幸存者偏差),并如实报告不确定性与局限。
howto.when: 当你提出一个需要数据回答的业务问题、要审查一份分析再决定是否行动,或想知道为何两人看同一数据得出相反结论时触发。

say.text: 我这个月销售额涨了,能帮我验证是不是活动带来的吗?
say.note: Claude 会先确认比较基准与反事实。

say.text: 帮我审查这份留存率分析,结论靠谱吗?
say.note: Claude 会检查数据口径与常见陷阱。

say.text: 两人对同一批数据得出相反结论,帮我判断谁对。
say.note: Claude 会拆解比较对象与推断依据。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude helps you answer business questions with data: frame the question so an answer could change a decision, pick the right comparison, inspect data before trusting it, flag common traps, and report uncertainty honestly.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to run an analysis, review one before acting on it, or figure out why two people reach opposite conclusions from the same data.

say_en.text: Sales are up this month. Can you check whether the campaign caused it?
say_en.note: Claude asks for the comparison baseline first.

say_en.text: Review this retention analysis. Is the conclusion sound?
say_en.note: Claude checks the data definitions and traps.

say_en.text: Two people read the same data and disagree. Help me judge who is right.
say_en.note: Claude breaks down the comparisons and assumptions.
